events.verdict: Duren (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in Mitchell's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Ware (MIA) places a hand against Cunningham's (DET) body as he moves alongside of his path to the basket, but he does not extend it into him.
Harris (DET) places his off-arm against Robinson (MIA) with slight extension and the contact is marginal.
Harris (DET) mishandles the ball and the ensuing contact with Adebayo (MIA) after the ball is already loose is incidental.
Beasley (DET) firms up in a screening position in Mitchell's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Mitchell (MIA) legally contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Duren (DET) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Robinson (MIA) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Harris (DET) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Adebayo (MIA) firms up in a screening position in Schroder's (DET) path. Schroder briefly grasps Adebayo's leg following the screen, but immediately disengages.
Duren (DET) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Herro (MIA) and he initiates illegal body contact during Herro's shooting motion.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) cleanly blocks Mitchell's (MIA) shot attempt as time expires.
